validation.nativeActivationContract: Compiled against the real 0.2.1-alpha.2 @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent types: the spec carries provider, label, reserved childId, request {parent, prompt, maxDepth?, cwd?}, signal and delivery 'parent', and the returned handle exposes childId, messageId and result.

review.independentReview: Owner review of the model-visible text: the owner rejected log-style narration, required text that states only what to do, and removed two clauses the plugin has no business stating (route inheritance, which the host injects itself, and 'never create a second child for the same ticket', which the binding layer does not restrict). The host-native activation seam came from the installed 0.2.1-alpha.2 packages and was verified by compiling the exact call shape against those real types plus isolated dual-host runs of the accepted archive.
